name: A-CEoH (Algorithmic Contextual EoH)
org: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology and TU Dortmund University
one_liner: EoH with the A* search code pasted into every prompt, so the LLM designs a guiding heuristic with the algorithm in view.

loop.proposes: Guiding heuristic functions for A* search, as thought plus code
loop.judged_by: Running A* with the heuristic on instances (solved count, fitness, time)
loop.steers: Fitness drives EoH selection; the A* source code is kept in every prompt

headline_result: For unit-load pre-marshalling, Qwen2.5-Coder:32b-generated heuristics solved 30 of 30 held-out instances (seeds 10-39) against 27 of 30 for the "Optimal A*" baseline. For the sliding puzzle they solved 10 of 10 on seeds 0-9 against 5 of 10 for Hybrid A* and for "Optimal A*".
caveat: Two domains. Where both solve, the LLM heuristics give worse solutions than A* (puzzle fitness 0.281 against 0.252 on shared instances). The paper gives no numeric EoH baseline for the final heuristics, only a qualitative claim of improvement. Accepted at EvoStar.
beyond_harness_note: An evolutionary loop designs a heuristic that is plugged into a classical A* search and then runs without the model.
algorithmic_authority: A* runs on instances (solved or not, plan quality, time)

sources.title: Algorithmic Prompt-Augmentation for Efficient LLM-Based Heuristic Design for A* Search

verification.notes: Resolved arXiv:2601.19622 (Bomer, Koltermann, Disselnmeyer, Amberg; v1 27 Jan 2026; comment 'accepted at EvoStar'). Solved-count tables read from the HTML (percentages are my arithmetic). Affiliations assumed to match the CEoH authors (KIT / TU Dortmund) and not checked on this paper. Report's 'pre-marshalling and sliding puzzles' confirmed. Parent set to eoh as a variant of CEoH/EoH. Org confirmed from the arXiv HTML: KIT (4 authors) and TU Dortmund (1) (review 2026-11-03).
